column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-7 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# independently authored expectation. The ids are the metric keys the capacity/topology
# battery is obliged to record, read off this phase's contract.
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   metrics   the metric keys in gen/dsl/phase7/phase-results.tsv
#   checks    the check ids tools/phase7_gate.py implements
# Several surfaces share a metric on purpose. `fits-equivalence` and
# `elementwise-topology-compatibility` are two readings of the same 3x3 compatibility
# matrix, and `rke2-host-distinctness` and `linux-host-quorum-compile-barriers` are two of
# the seven compile-fail pairs. Inventing a distinct metric per surface would name the
# same observation twice and make the join look stronger than the evidence is.
# The last five surfaces are the ones this register cannot reach; they carry the metrics
# whose recorded value is the literal `UNVERIFIED`, or no metric at all.
